pattern: lookup of unknown size with a subagent and context_rewind available -> report which the agent chose
experience: An agent cannot know a lookup is large before it runs it; a subagent keeps the raw result out of context from the start, and context_rewind drops it afterwards. This case records which the agent chooses and checks nothing.
